decision.section: Iterate - bug: Windows-safe npx spawn and Browser Verify URL
decision.title: Resolve npx per platform and pass the profile URL to Browser Verify
decision.context: B4 doubt review found bare npx spawns fail on Windows (npx.cmd), the Browser Verify command omitted --url, smoke and Browser Verify disagreed on URL precedence, and localhost can resolve to ::1 for Node while uvicorn listens on IPv4.
decision.decision: playwright_runner and browser_verify resolve npx via the shared resolve_executable (argv arrays, no shell). browser-verify.md carries --url in its code block. Precedence is profile dev_server, then build_config dev_url. chat-first-json and step-7 guidance use 127.0.0.1 everywhere.
decision.consequences: Windows runs (campaign B7) no longer fail at spawn. playwright_runner loads the shared helper by file path (plugin has its own lib package, ADR-045) with a shutil.which fallback.
decision.rationale: Same resolver playwright_setup.py already uses; no shell=True keeps profile strings out of a shell.
decision.rejected: shell=True (injection surface); import lib.cmd_resolver from the plugin (lib name collision).

changelog.bullet: Playwright and Browser Verify find npx on Windows, and the chat-first profile is checked at 127.0.0.1 with --url passed explicitly

behaviors.behavior: playwright_runner spawns npx through the resolver (Windows npx.cmd), no shell
browser_verify spawns npx through resolve_executable and forwards --url, no shell
chat-first-json dev_server declares 127.0.0.1 in host and uvicorn command; profile still valid
adopt matcher unchanged and CI/CodeQL mapping stays none (retagged FR-01.13)
browser-verify.md --url code block, URL precedence wording, step-7 host guidance
behaviors.reason: prompt text read by an agent; live proof is campaign unit B7's real end-to-end run
